title: test(data-objectstack): state the batch-6 DroppedFieldsEvent reason pin with stored_expression subtracted (objectui#13309)
body:
Fixes #13309
Clause-②: no

## What was red

objectstack-ai/objectstack#24778 (merge `7532ea3c08`) added a fifth arm, `stored_expression`, to `DroppedFieldsEventSchema.reason`. The batch-6 pin `_ReasonIsTheEnum` in `packages/data-objectstack/src/spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts` stated the union as exactly four members, so objectstack's hourly Spec Shape Gate (objectui `main` compiled against the spec built from objectstack `main`) reports `TS2344` on it.

## The change

The objectui#11206 shape, as the card prescribes: `_ReasonIsTheEnum` now asserts `Equal` of (`DroppedFieldsEvent['reason']` with `'stored_expression'` removed by `Exclude`) against `'readonly' | 'readonly_when' | 'primary_key' | 'computed'`. `_ReasonIsNotString` is kept unchanged. The comment above it says: the `Exclude` is a no-op at the pin; on objectstack `main` it subtracts exactly the new arm, so any other new arm is still a remainder `Equal` refuses; at the pin bump that carries `stored_expression` the `Exclude` is dropped and the union becomes five members (the objectui#13178 tripwire in `writeWarningToast.test.ts` fails on that bump to say so).

No source file changed. `.objectstack-sha` did not move. A `.changeset/13309-dropped-fields-reason-pin.md` with an empty frontmatter is added because `check-changeset-presence` counts a test file under `src/` as published source (it exits 1 without it, measured).

## Measurements (test file blob identical at `7f58b8c400` and head `6ee70cebc3`; the head commit adds only the changeset)

| spec compiled against | tree | `pnpm --filter @object-ui/data-objectstack run type-check` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| pinned spec (`.objectstack-sha` `06cab4849a`) | this branch | exit 0 |
| pinned spec | base `2794254099` | exit 0 (control) |
| spec built from objectstack `main` `28c9a2cb66` | base `2794254099` | exit 2, `TS2344` on `_ReasonIsTheEnum` (the card's red, reproduced) |
| spec built from objectstack `main` `28c9a2cb66` | this branch | exit 0 |

The `main` side reproduces the gate's own wiring: an objectstack worktree at `origin/main`, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter @objectstack/spec...`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, `npm pack --ignore-scripts`, then `node scripts/ci/spec-shape-gate.mjs inject` into this worktree (marker file present in the resolved copy, `stored_expression` in its declarations). The closure (`@object-ui/data-objectstack^...`) was rebuilt against it before the type-check. Afterwards the injected copy was removed and `pnpm run setup` reinstalled the pin (no marker left, no `stored_expression` in the installed declarations), and the pin row above was re-measured after a fresh closure rebuild.

**Sixth-arm probe (one-shot, not kept):** a local alias `_ProbeReason` = the reason union plus `'sixth_arm_probe'` was put in place of `DroppedFieldsEvent['reason']` inside the `Exclude`. On-disk anchor count checked before compiling (1). Result: `TS2344` on `_ReasonIsTheEnum`, exit 2, against both the `main`-built spec and the pinned spec. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH` under an `EXIT INT TERM` trap; proof is the HEAD blob hash comparison (match) and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Gates (local, at the branch head)

- vitest, root form, `--maxWorkers=1`: `spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts` + `writeWarningToast.test.ts` 2 files / 36 tests passed; `deleteViewContract.types.test.ts` + `queryDataset.test.ts` (the other tests naming the file) 2 files / 38 tests passed. The full `packages/data-objectstack/` and `packages/app-shell/` directories are declared to CI.
- `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: all exit 0.
- `check:spec-floors`: exit 1, the known prerelease-floor reading for `@object-ui/types` on `main`; not touched here.
- Lint, narrowed: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the one changed `.ts` file: 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The package's `lint` is `eslint .`, so the file is in its population; type-aware linting is off (no `project` / `projectService` in the printed config), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.

## Acceptance notes

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#25055 (the objectstack half) has PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#25091 open, not merged, registering this diagnostic in `scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json` with this card as `downstream_card`. Once this lands, that entry reads "matched nothing in this run" and is deleted when this card closes.
